Uttarakhand Teen Selected for International North Pole Scientific Expedition

Lucky Rawat, a 17-year-old student from Uttarakhand, has been selected to participate in an international scientific expedition to the North Pole. The 10-day expedition will involve students from 22 countries. Rawat will represent India on this scientific journey.
